Breastfeeding should be suspended until concentrations normalize. The time for milk iodine levels to normalize is unknown, but may be 2 weeks or longer, depending on the dose. Drug Levels and Effects > Drug Levels

Maternal Levels. A nursing mother with metastatic thyroid cancer developed a chyle leak on postoperative day 1 after a modified radical neck dissection. After unsuccessful conservative management of the chyle leak, the interventional radiology service performed a lymphangiography and sclerotherapy under general anesthesia on postoperative day 2. The patient received 30 mL of iohexol for imaging, and 20 mL of ethiodized oil for imaging and sclerotherapy. The iodine concentrations in frozen pumped milk collected on post-procedure days 8 to 11 yielded iodine ranging from 9.6 to 21.2 ppm, 50 to 100 times the typical human milk concentration, without a consistent decline over time.
